item.text: [{"task_id":"1bfc4729","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    axis = int(round(params['rule'][1])) % 2","    thickness = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    work = grid.T if axis else grid","    height, width = work.shape","    out = np.full(work.shape, background, dtype=int)","    seeds = np.argwhere(work != background)","    if len(seeds) == 0 or thickness <= 0:","        return out.T if axis else out","    for r in range(height):","        nearest = None","        distance = None","        for seed in seeds:","            d = abs(r - int(seed[0]))","            if distance is None or d < distance:","                distance = d","                nearest = seed","        color = int(work[int(nearest[0]), int(nearest[1])])","        for c in range(width):","            if r < thickness or r >= height - thickness or c < thickness or c >= width - thickness or distance < thickness:","                out[r, c] = color","    return out.T if axis else out"],"shapes":{"rule":[3]},"params":{"rule":[0,0,1]},"rationale":"Each marker expands across its row. The outer border is painted with the color of the nearest marker row, producing an upper and lower colored frame. The tensors specify background, orientation, and stroke thickness; zeroed tensors produce a blank output."}]
